title: Fix enumerated guard in event-schema coverage test
goal: Replace the hardcoded _PLUGIN_NS_RE list with a manifest-derived guard, and remove the mis-filed events from event-schema.json and the plugin manifests.

steps.description: Rewrite the guard in `tests/unit/event-schema-emitted-coverage-test.sh` to derive plugin-owned namespaces dynamically by scanning `plugins/*/*/manifest.yaml`, excluding ADR-001 engine namespaces, and implementing the `plugin.pr_open.*` exception only for `plugins/tool/pr-open`; remove `_PLUGIN_NS_RE` entirely (R1, R2, R5). Run the suite and confirm the new assertions fail red because `config/event-schema.json` still declares `persist.*` and `hydrate.*`.

Add an assertion to `tests/unit/event-schema-emitted-coverage-test.sh` that no plugin manifest declares an engine event (R3). Run the suite and confirm the assertion fails red because `plugin.result` is still in the security-lens and merge manifests.
Remove all `persist.*` and `hydrate.*` event declarations from `config/event-schema.json` (R4, first part). The R1 assertions from step-1 must now go green.

Remove `plugin.result` from `plugins/agent/security-lens/manifest.yaml` and `plugins/tool/merge/manifest.yaml`, and in the same change remove the sub-assertions in `plugins/agent/security-lens/tests/security-lens-test.sh` [SPEC-16] and `tests/unit/merge-v2-result-test.sh` [SPEC-1] that assert plugin.result IS present in those manifests — those assertions become false and would leave the suite broken otherwise (R4, second part). The R3 assertion from step-2 must now go green.

Add an `## Enforced by` section to `docs/adr/ADR-001-plugin-contract.md` naming `tests/unit/event-schema-emitted-coverage-test.sh`, and remove `ADR-001-plugin-contract.md` from `config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt` — the baseline only shrinks, and the lint script requires that ADRs with an Enforced-by section are absent from it.
